external_evidence: The PyTorch CPU index publishes torchvision 0.27.1+df56172 with only win_arm64 wheels alongside the +cpu builds. Local version segments compare as 'df56172' > 'cpu', so that build is the highest version. The index's version/wheel layout is the root cause.

related_issues.reason: Earlier torch/torchvision resolution problem with PyTorch indexes and local versions via tool.uv.sources

rationale: uv resolves universally and picks the highest version, and the PyTorch index's win_arm64-only +df56172 local version sorts above +cpu. The package-metadata tool did not show the index's file list, and searches found no matching duplicate. Likely fixes are an index-side cleanup or a user-side pin, such as constraint-dependencies on torchvision==0.27.1+cpu or tool.uv.environments restricted to Linux. Not clearly a uv contract violation, though a maintainer might treat platform-aware local-version selection as an enhancement.
